follow-up time: From 28-30 weeks gestation to 34-36 weeks gestation
exposure: Individual counseling program by a midwife
outcome: Fear of childbirth (measured using the Wijma Delivery Expectancy/Experience Questionnaire)
cohort: 90 primiparous women with gestational ages of 28-30 weeks
finding: An individual counseling program delivered by midwives to primiparous women during pregnancy significantly reduced fear of childbirth.
